items.title: Edgar "Sambo" Joseph Interview, 1960-08-07
items.q: I had Eddie Johnson with me... I had Eddie Johnson. I had Manuel Serra's on Ghetto. They didn't use these bands. They used Ghetto on Converse Show. Bigfoot, Billy, myself. We played all that, man.

ctx.x: I'd like you to see that, see how that thing, how that heat gets there. You can come in there. I've seen some pictures of the inside. Inside. What he wins the prize every year on the best Christmas lights. You think he must cost him money? He gets them big, you know them big cranes that put them lights, neon lights all night. He put them cranes to put them lights in. It's beautiful to see. What he had farms and all that. You understand me? Well, nothing to catch you on the fire. Next time I'm in there, they said,…
Well, I guess that Jeezy just made him feel good. That's right.
